stories.title: The colour of confidence.
stories.intro: Warm yellow. Cool blue. A smile that makes the frame its own.
stories.note: This portrait study follows the conversation between colour and expression. The wider frame gives the pose room to breathe; the closer portrait draws attention to a smile, a gesture, and the light on the face.

stories.title: The city doesn't pose.
stories.intro: A crossing, a passing car, a quiet pause. The everyday becomes the story.
stories.note: Road markings, passing traffic and everyday objects become part of the composition. These photographs move between a wider street scene and a more personal portrait, holding onto the character of the surroundings.

stories.title: After the lights come on.
stories.intro: Purple washes. Blue light. A saxophone held between the music and the moment.
stories.note: Live performance brings its own palette. Purple and blue stage light shape these frames, while the instruments, gestures and space around the performers tell the rest of the story.
